mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, increasing present value and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependency.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate falls below 0.5% for two consecutive months, it signals extreme monetary stimulus that precedes positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days as markets price in policy support.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances meeting the rate threshold condition.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in non-farm payrolls signals labor market recovery, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings to drive positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint signal fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During post-crisis recovery periods, retail sales (RSAFS) exceeding 12-month moving average indicates strengthening consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days as earnings expectations rise.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of post-crisis recovery periods when RSAFS is above 12-month MA, or Rank IC falls below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO) signals economic contraction, reducing corporate profit expectations and driving negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days without regime dependency.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO declines, or Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) falling below 600,000 units for two consecutive months signals deepening housing crisis, triggering negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days due to financial sector stress.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances meeting the housing start threshold condition.

mechanism_narrative: In high-unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 7.0%), a decline in unemployment rate signals labor market stabilization, boosting consumer confidence and corporate earnings to drive positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 7.0 and UNRATE declines, or Rank IC for decline signal is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in federal funds rate and rise in CPIAUCSL signals monetary policy response to inflation, stabilizing economic outlook and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: The joint signal fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.03.
